periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downwards toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio; length is approximately 2.5 times the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point extending significantly below the eye center towards the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve with a broad, relatively flat posterior margin.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Wide lateral thickness, approximately 30% of the visible dorsal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation between pinnae, approximately twice the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular apex curvature without visible flattening or notches.
